meaning_en: A person who studies human history through excavation.
example_en: Archaeologists unearthed ancient pottery at the site.
examples_extra: The archaeologist found ancient coins.
She works as an archaeologist.

meaning_en: Protective covering, especially worn by soldiers in battle.
example_en: Medieval knights wore heavy armour into battle.
examples_extra: Knights wore suits of armour.
The tank has thick armour.

meaning_en: A prehistoric period characterized by bronze tools.
example_en: Artifacts from the Bronze Age were discovered.
examples_extra: The Bronze Age began about 5000 years ago.
They found Bronze Age tools.
note_fa: عصر برنز؛ the Iron Age یعنی عصر آهن.

meaning_en: Soldiers who fight on horseback.
example_en: The cavalry charged across the battlefield during the war.
examples_extra: The cavalry arrived at dawn.
He served in the cavalry.
note_fa: کتاب: cavalry = soldiers on horseback؛ سواره‌نظام.

meaning_en: A two-wheeled vehicle pulled by horses, used in ancient times.
example_en: Roman soldiers often rode into battle in chariots.
examples_extra: Romans raced chariots for sport.
The king rode a golden chariot.
note_fa: کتاب: chariot = two-wheeled vehicle؛ ارابه جنگی.

meaning_en: The act of conquering or taking control.
example_en: The Norman Conquest of England occurred in 1066.
examples_extra: The conquest of the island took three years.
His conquest of Mount Everest made headlines.
note_fa: هم فتح نظامی، هم غلبه بر چالش؛ با conquer هم‌خانواده است.

meaning_en: The ceremony of crowning a monarch.
example_en: The coronation of the new king was a grand event.
examples_extra: The coronation took place in the cathedral.
Millions watched the coronation on television.
note_fa: مراسم تاج‌گذاری؛ با crown هم‌خانواده است.

meaning_en: The beginning of a phenomenon or period.
example_en: The invention of the printing press marked the dawn of a new era.
examples_extra: We left home at dawn this morning.
It was the dawn of a new era.

meaning_en: A succession of rulers from the same family.
example_en: The Ming Dynasty ruled China for nearly 300 years.
examples_extra: The ancient dynasty lasted for nearly 300 years.
He founded a powerful business dynasty here.

meaning_en: A large group of states or countries under one ruler.
example_en: The Roman Empire lasted for centuries.
examples_extra: The Roman Empire lasted for many centuries.
She built a vast business empire.
note_fa: امپراتوری؛ گروه بزرگی از کشورها زیر یک فرمانروا.

meaning_en: A person who travels to discover new places.
example_en: Famous explorers charted unknown territories centuries ago.
examples_extra: The young explorer mapped the river.
Famous explorers crossed the desert on foot.

meaning_en: A large, multi-decked sailing ship, used historically.
example_en: Spanish galleons carried treasure across the oceans.
examples_extra: The galleon sailed across the ocean.
A Spanish galleon sank near the coast.

meaning_en: Soldiers who fight on foot.
example_en: The infantry advanced slowly across the battlefield.
examples_extra: The infantry advanced on foot.
He served in the infantry.

meaning_en: A person doing unskilled manual work for wages.
example_en: Many labourers built the ancient pyramids.
examples_extra: The labourer carried bricks all day.
Labourers built the new road.

meaning_en: An original text written by hand or typed.
example_en: Ancient monasteries preserved many valuable manuscripts.
examples_extra: Her first manuscript was over 500 pages long.
He submitted his long manuscript to three publishers.

meaning_en: Relating to the Middle Ages (about 500-1500 AD).
example_en: We visited a fascinating medieval castle.
examples_extra: The ancient stone castle dates from medieval times.
She now studies medieval European history at Oxford.

meaning_en: A person involved in wholesale trade, especially internationally.
example_en: Medieval merchants traveled far to trade spices.
examples_extra: The wealthy merchant sailed to many distant ports.
She comes from a proud old merchant family.

meaning_en: A sovereign head of state, like a king or queen.
example_en: The monarch's reign lasted for over fifty years.
examples_extra: The British monarch opened parliament again yesterday.
Spain still has a constitutional monarch today.

meaning_en: The group of people belonging to the aristocracy.
example_en: The king granted titles to members of the nobility.
examples_extra: She proudly came from the old French nobility.
The local nobility owned vast estates of land.

meaning_en: A poor farmer of low social status.
example_en: In medieval times, most people were peasants.
examples_extra: The peasants worked the land.
He was born a peasant.

meaning_en: Relating to the period after a country gains independence.
example_en: Many post-colonial nations faced new challenges.
examples_extra: The novel explores post-colonial identity.
She studies post-colonial literature at university.
note_fa: پسااستعماری؛ مربوط به دوره پس از استقلال.

meaning_en: Existing before a region was colonized by a foreign power.
example_en: We studied the pre-colonial history of the continent.
examples_extra: The museum shows pre-colonial art.
They study pre-colonial history of the region.

meaning_en: A period of European cultural, artistic, and scientific rebirth.
example_en: The Renaissance marked a significant shift in European thought.
examples_extra: The Renaissance changed European art.
She studies beautiful Renaissance painting.

meaning_en: To tear or cut something into small pieces.
example_en: The old documents were shredded for security.
examples_extra: Shred the documents before binning.
She shredded the lettuce finely.

meaning_en: A person owned by another and forced to work.
example_en: Slaves were denied basic human rights.
examples_extra: He was sold as a slave.
They freed all the slaves.

meaning_en: The practice of owning people as property.
example_en: The abolition of slavery was a major historical event.
examples_extra: Slavery was abolished in the 19th century.
They fought hard against slavery.

meaning_en: A person or thing that takes another's place.
example_en: The new CEO is the successor to the founder.
examples_extra: She named her successor last week.
The new king's successor is his son.

meaning_en: A complete set of metal protection worn by knights.
example_en: The museum displayed an impressive suit of armour.
examples_extra: A suit of armour stood in the hall.
Knights wore heavy suits of armour.

meaning_en: A military leader with local power, not part of a national army.
example_en: The region was controlled by a powerful warlord.
examples_extra: The warlord controlled the region.
Local warlords fought for power.
